calibration_question: What is the lowest predeclared departure-density multiplier at which the frozen A1B1 one-lane-loss event produces a reproducible, non-catastrophic, directly exposed and scientifically measurable fixed-time baseline response on all three calibration seeds?
calibration_hypothesis: At least one of 2X, 3X, 4X or 5X will satisfy every frozen integrity, usability, exposure, network-response and local-response gate on all three calibration seeds.

demand_generation.description: Extend the frozen 1X generator exactly: initialize Python random.Random(seed), then for each 60-second block shuffle list(ROUTES)*multiplier once and assign slot k to integer second block*60 + floor(k*60/(12*multiplier)). This reproduces the frozen 1X route schedule when multiplier=1 and creates multiplier departures per original five-second stratum.

qualification_contract.event_entry_semantics: A unique passenger edge visit whose one-second entry transition interval overlaps [300,600): interval_end>300 and interval_start<600. Preexisting occupants are not entries.

local_physical_response.criterion: At least one directly exposed vehicle has increased A1B1 time, positive additional A1B1 halting, or delayed final arrival in D0 versus N0.
local_physical_response.missing_or_ambiguous_pairing_rule: If no positive witness exists and any potentially decisive visit or arrival comparison is missing or ambiguous, the local gate is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. A positive edge-time, edge-halting, or valid-arrival witness passes even when another comparison is unavailable.
local_physical_response.pairing: Pair each D0 event-entry vehicle to its unique A1B1 visit in D0 and unique A1B1 traversal in matched N0; fixed routes contain A1B1 at most once. Any multiple-visit ambiguity is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.

qualification_contract.seed_pair_state_rule: INTEGRITY_FAILURE if integrity is contradicted; otherwise DOES_NOT_QUALIFY if any scientific gate definitively fails; otherwise NOT_IDENTIFIABLE if any required gate is unknown; otherwise QUALIFIES.

recovery_diagnostic.decline_rule: At least one later post-restoration sample is below the earliest maximum positive excess queue.
recovery_diagnostic.near_zero_rule: After the earliest positive peak and a strict decline, positive excess queue is <=1 at some sample strictly before H_PILOT.

selection_rule.level_state_rule: A level QUALIFIES only when all three seed pairs QUALIFY. Any definitive seed nonqualification makes the level DOES_NOT_QUALIFY even if a different seed is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. With no definitive failure, any NOT_IDENTIFIABLE seed stops selection as INCONCLUSIVE.

status_contract.FAIL: Executed input, implementation, integrity, public-repository, or freeze/readback contradiction.
status_contract.BLOCKED: The local environment prevents a required run or durable write without a scientific contradiction.
status_contract.INCONCLUSIVE: A required selection decision remains semantically ambiguous after otherwise trustworthy evidence.
status_contract.NO_QUALIFYING_DEMAND_LEVEL: All four levels definitively do not qualify without integrity defects or unresolved ambiguity.
status_contract.PASS: The first qualifier passes all three seeds, exact repeat, and freeze readback.

interpretation_boundary.establishes_only: Whether a frozen physical disruption produces enough measurable fixed-time baseline traffic response for later method comparisons.
